details:
- CVE-2026-44517: resolve the context subdirectory of a git or archive URL
  inside the download directory and fail an ADD whose git repository cannot be
  fetched, so that a crafted source cannot bring host files into the build
- CVE-2026-39831: require the user presence flag in security key (sk-ecdsa,
  sk-ed25519) signatures unless no-touch-required is set, in the vendored
  golang.org/x/crypto/ssh
- CVE-2026-111943: rebuild el9_2 against golang >= 1.22.9-1.el9_2.tuxcare.els31
  and el9_6 against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els22 to stop crypto/x509
  Verify from trusting compromised intermediate CAs
